why: Self-corrections resolved to the final intent, not just the last word (fill-calendar-022).
behaviour: the speaker corrects themselves without an edit command, once or twice: changes a day, time, amount, name or detail ("Thursday, no, Friday", "the arnona, sorry, the water bill", "eleven, no wait, twelve thousand"), sometimes changing their mind back and forth before settling
rule: Resolve every self-correction to the speaker's final intent and drop the earlier versions and the correcting words (no, sorry, I mean, actually), rewording the sentence just enough to read cleanly.
